description: This file defines the AuthenticationService interface for verifying client credentials during SASL authentication exchanges in the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: AuthenticationService
classes.description: Interface for authenticating users via SASL exchange, providing the 'authenticate' method.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user based on SASL exchange information provided in a JsonObject, invoking the handler with the result.
